executiveNotes: Paper-only. No real exchange orders are authorized or executed.
Last 24hr Trades shows the aggressive paper profile activity so churn is visible, not hidden inside a summary.
Negative net-edge rows mean the trade did not beat estimated fees/spread/noise at entry.
Expected Price uses the aggressive profile target: sell buys around +1.2%, or buy back sells around -1.2% from the paper trade price.
Status marks a trade Closed only when later opposite paper trades fully offset its amount; partial offsets remain Open.
Price Closed is the weighted average opposite-side paper price that fully closed that row.
